question: If you compared the royal candidates and their knights to the cast of a school, what sort of positions would they end up in?
answer: Crusch - student council president. Ferris - vice president. Priscilla - daughter of the chairman of the board. Al - Priscilla’s chauffeur. Anastasia - student council treasurer. Julius - student council secretary. Reinhard - prince of the school. Felt - main character of a girl’s dating sim. Subaru - side character. Rem - Subaru’s childhood friend. Emilia - transfer student. Beako - Subaru’s little sister. With these selections, you have Re: Zero School!! How’s that?
